title: Cross Domain Discovery
definition: The process of finding meaningful connections and insights between concepts from different disciplines or domains.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it like a smart librarian who knows your topic and finds books from different sections to help you better understand it.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Cross-domain discovery is an AI technique that leverages the power of semantic search to expand the scope of a query beyond its immediate context, enabling the discovery of relevant concepts from various related domains.
difficulty_levels.expert: Cross-domain discovery is a novel approach in AI that not only enhances search accuracy but also fosters interdisciplinary understanding and innovation. By combining the strengths of keyword matching and semantic query expansion, it offers a more comprehensive and nuanced exploration of complex concepts. This technique challenges traditional siloed knowledge systems, promoting cross-pollination and collaborative exploration of diverse fields.

extra_fields.insight: The hybrid search, combining keyword matching with Mistral-powered semantic query expansion, successfully identified cross-domain concepts that were not present in the original query.
